catalog_snapshot.tidal_radius_definition: Header identifies Eq. 8 of Webb et al. 2013; phase-corrected limiting-radius estimate, not an independently measured instantaneous Jacobi saddle.
catalog_snapshot.uncertainty_use: Quoted R error is recorded but not propagated; no radius uncertainty is supplied. No independence from the host fit is assumed.

literature.role: Empirical limiting radius in star-cluster density profiles; distinct from a dynamical escape condition.
Above-threshold energy permits potential escapers with delayed escape; it is not an instantaneous removal rule.
